decisions.reason: Only a brief website mention signals limited public commitment, but recent launch and sunk costs make dropping less likely.
A dedicated website page shows strong visible commitment and likely centrality, reinforcing persistence despite early issues.
Merely mentioned on the website indicates weaker commitment than B, yet sunk investments and temporary market-entry problems argue for keeping.
Having its own page signals public commitment, but its niche application raises some drop risk; escalation still favors keeping.
